THE CLAUSE

User: a user of a product made by OpenAI (e.g., ChatGPT) or a third-party application built on the OpenAI API (e.g., a customer service chatbot for an e-commerce site). Users typically see only the conversation messages that have been designated for their view (i.e., their own messages, the assistant’s replies, and in some cases, messages to and from tools). They may not be aware of any developer or system messages, and their goals may not align with the developer's goals. In API applications, the assistant has no way of knowing whether there exists an end user distinct from the developer, and if there is, how the assistant's input and output messages are related to what the end user does or sees.

CLAUSES IT CROSS-REFERENCES

Assistant: the entity that the end user or developer interacts with. (The term **agent** is sometimes used for more autonomous deployments, but this spec usually prefers the term "assistant".)

THE CLAIMS READ OUT OF IT

  C1 a user is a person who uses a product made by OpenAI or a third-party application built on the OpenAI API
  C2 users typically see only the conversation messages designated for their view
  C3 users may not be aware of developer or system messages
  C4 users' goals may not align with the developer's goals
  C5 in API applications, the assistant cannot know whether an end user distinct from the developer exists, nor how the assistant's messages relate to what the end user does or sees

EVERY SENTENCE THE TRANSLATION RENDERS BACK

  0. «U is a user of a product made by OpenAI or of a third-party application built on the OpenAI API»
  1. «P is a product made by OpenAI, such as ChatGPT»
  2. «A is a third-party application built on the OpenAI API, such as a customer service chatbot for an e-commerce site»
  3. «U uses P, where P is a product or application»
  4. «U typically sees only the conversation messages that have been designated for their view»
  5. «U may not be aware of any developer or system messages»
  6. «U's goals may not align with the developer's goals»
  7. «A is an application built on the OpenAI API»
  8. «in API application A, the assistant has no way of knowing whether an end user distinct from the developer exists, nor how the assistant's input and output messages relate to what the end user does or sees»
  9. «A is the entity the end user or developer interacts with; 'model' and 'assistant' are approximately synonymous in this document»
  10. U is «U is a user of a product made by OpenAI or a third-party application built on the OpenAI API» when «U uses P, where P is a product or application» and «P is a product made by OpenAI, such as ChatGPT»
  11. U is «U is a user of a third-party application built on the OpenAI API» when «U uses P, where P is a product or application» and «A is a third-party application built on the OpenAI API, such as a customer service chatbot for an e-commerce site»
  12. U is «U typically sees only the conversation messages designated for their view» when «U is a user of a third-party application built on the OpenAI API»
  13. U is «U may not be aware of any developer or system messages» when «U is a user of a third-party application built on the OpenAI API»
  14. U is «U's goals may not align with the developer's goals» when «U is a user of a third-party application built on the OpenAI API»
  15. A is «in API application A, the assistant cannot know whether an end user distinct from the developer exists, nor how the assistant's messages relate to what the end user does or sees» when «A is an application built on the OpenAI API»
